programmes.d: Karp and his associates, who make their living lawfully by taking skins from range cattle, find themselves confronted by the law when they go beyond their legal rights and do exactly as they please.
Three teenage boys, on probation from the county jail, are welcomed in Dodge City for a while.
A little cowboy, a giant horse and a 2 1/2 ton elephant are featured in this comedy episode.
A man who has had every motive to commit a murder swears that he is innocent.
A mild-mannered bank teller, about to be dismissed, foils a bank robber but impulsively takes some money for himself.
A retired star of a Wild West show returns to Dodge City in an attempt to rekindle a 20-year-old romance.
A fur trapper whose adopted Indian son is beaten and left to die by five Army deserters sets out to track down the assailants.
When Festus and a wounded robber are put up at a farmhouse the owner attempts to kill the robber and seize the stolen money.
When Matt arrests a young stagecoach robber, his notorious older brother and his gang pursue the marshal, seeking his death.
Two men try to force a Chinese man out of Dodge.
A contemptible father pretends to have a change of heart when three nuns confront him about the care and custody of his two children.
Vicious Phoebe Strunk and her four criminal sons climax a round of murder and robbery by kidnapping a young girl.
An ambitious mother doesn't consider Newly O'Brien or a neighboring farmer suitable suitors for her daughter, provoking them into a fight which almost leads to tragedy.
A wealthy rancher has three drifters trampled by his horsemen after he accuses them of stealing a calf.
At Parkertown a trap awaits drifter Bob Johnson who is seeking revenge for the murder of two of his friends.
Craig Stevens, Kurt Russell and Tom Simcox are guest stars in the story of a farm youth's grim track down of the man who killed his father.
A cowhand accused of murder assists Marshal Dillon when the latter's eyesight is impaired in an attack by three desperadoes. (TV-PG)

A respectable rancher and his son hang an innocent man and let a bewhiskered bounty hunter go on trial for the murder.
Doc and pretty saloon owner Lyla Ross find themselves virtual slaves when they are kidnapped by a band of former Confederate officers-turned-outlaws.
With Doc overdue and a stage coach with three passengers missing, Matt, Festus, and Newly set out to find their friend in the conclusion of the two-part episode.
Newly finds himself in a strange alliance with a professional killer as he tries to get his prisoner to Dodge City before they are both killed by bounty hunters.
